export default "# 20 · 工程化与监控\n> 从\"能跑\"到\"能上生产\"\n\n## 是什么\n\n**工程化**是把代码变成\"可观测、可维护、可发布\"产品的过程。包括：\n\n- 统一异常 / 响应 / 日志\n- 接口文档\n- 监控告警\n- CI/CD\n- 配置中心\n\n## 1. 项目骨架\n\n```\nmall/\n├── pom.xml                    # 父 POM\n├── mall-common/               # 公共模块（Result/异常/工具）\n├── mall-domain/               # 领域模型（DO/Enum）\n├── mall-api/                  # API 模块\n├── mall-service/              # 业务实现\n│   ├── controller/\n│   ├── service/\n│   │   └── impl/\n│   ├── mapper/\n│   ├── config/\n│   ├── job/                   # 定时任务\n│   ├── mq/                    # MQ 消费\n│   └── web/                   # 拦截器、Filter\n├── mall-app/                  # 启动模块\n└── mall-start/                # 独立启动类\n```\n\n> 实际企业里**多模块**清晰，本工程 demo-04 演示。\n\n## 2. 配置管理\n\n### application.yml 分层\n\n```yaml\n# application.yml 公共\nspring:\n  application:\n    name: mall-service\n  profiles:\n    active: dev\n\nserver:\n  port: 8080\n\nmybatis-plus:\n  ...\n\nlogging:\n  level:\n    root: INFO\n    com.learnjava: DEBUG\n```\n\n```yaml\n# application-dev.yml 开发\nspring:\n  datasource:\n    url: jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/mall_dev\n```\n\n```yaml\n# application-prod.yml 生产\nspring:\n  datasource:\n    url: jdbc:mysql://${DB_HOST}:${DB_PORT}/mall_prod\n```\n\n### 配置中心（Nacos）\n\n```xml\n<dependency>\n    <groupId>com.alibaba.cloud</groupId>\n    <artifactId>spring-cloud-starter-alibaba-nacos-config</artifactId>\n    <version>2022.0.0.0-RC2</version>\n</dependency>\n```\n\n```yaml\nspring:\n  cloud:\n    nacos:\n      config:\n        server-addr: nacos:8848\n        file-extension: yaml\n```\n\n> 配置改完**热更新**不用重启。\n\n## 3. 日志规范\n\n### logback-spring.xml\n\n```xml\n<configuration>\n    <appender name=\"STDOUT\" class=\"ch.qos.logback.core.ConsoleAppender\">\n        <encoder>\n            <pattern>%d{yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS} %5p [%X{traceId}] [%t] %logger{36} - %msg%n</pattern>\n        </encoder>\n    </appender>\n\n    <appender name=\"FILE\" class=\"ch.qos.logback.core.rolling.RollingFileAppender\">\n        <file>logs/app.log</file>\n        <rollingPolicy class=\"ch.qos.logback.core.rolling.SizeAndTimeBasedRollingPolicy\">\n            <fileNamePattern>logs/app.%d{yyyy-MM-dd}.%i.log</fileNamePattern>\n            <maxFileSize>100MB</maxFileSize>\n            <maxHistory>30</maxHistory>\n        </rollingPolicy>\n    </appender>\n\n    <root level=\"INFO\">\n        <appender-ref ref=\"STDOUT\"/>\n        <appender-ref ref=\"FILE\"/>\n    </root>\n\n    <logger name=\"com.learnjava\" level=\"DEBUG\"/>\n</configuration>\n```\n\n### 关键日志点\n\n```java\nlog.info(\"收到请求: uri={}, params={}\", uri, params);\nlog.info(\"业务节点: userId={}, action={}\", userId, action);\nlog.warn(\"业务异常: code={}, msg={}\", code, msg);\nlog.error(\"系统异常: orderId={}\", orderId, throwable);\n```\n\n> **禁止**：\n> - 打密码、身份证、银行卡\n> - 循环里打日志\n> - `e.printStackTrace()`\n\n## 4. 接口文档（springdoc-openapi）\n\n```xml\n<dependency>\n    <groupId>org.springdoc</groupId>\n    <artifactId>springdoc-openapi-starter-webmvc-ui</artifactId>\n    <version>2.5.0</version>\n</dependency>\n```\n\n```java\n@Configuration\npublic class OpenApiConfig {\n\n    @Bean\n    public OpenAPI customOpenAPI() {\n        return new OpenAPI()\n            .info(new Info()\n                .title(\"Mall Service API\")\n                .version(\"1.0\")\n                .description(\"多租户商城后端 API\"))\n            .addSecurityItem(new SecurityRequirement().addList(\"bearerAuth\"))\n            .components(new Components()\n                .addSecuritySchemes(\"bearerAuth\",\n                    new SecurityScheme()\n                        .type(SecurityScheme.Type.HTTP)\n                        .scheme(\"bearer\")\n                        .bearerFormat(\"JWT\")));\n    }\n}\n```\n\nController 加注解：\n\n```java\n@Operation(summary = \"创建订单\")\n@ApiResponses({@ApiResponse(responseCode = \"200\", description = \"成功\")})\n@PostMapping\npublic Result<Long> create(@RequestBody OrderCreateReq req) { ... }\n```\n\n访问 `http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html`。\n\n## 5. 监控（Actuator + Prometheus + Grafana）\n\n### 引入\n\n```xml\n<dependency>\n    <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>\n    <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-actuator</artifactId>\n</dependency>\n<dependency>\n    <groupId>io.micrometer</groupId>\n    <artifactId>micrometer-registry-prometheus</artifactId>\n</dependency>\n```\n\n```yaml\nmanagement:\n  endpoints:\n    web:\n      exposure:\n        include: health,info,metrics,prometheus\n  endpoint:\n    health:\n      show-details: always\n  metrics:\n    tags:\n      application: mall-service\n```\n\n### 关键指标\n\n| 指标 | 含义 |\n| --- | --- |\n| `http_server_requests_seconds_count` | 请求数 |\n| `http_server_requests_seconds_sum` | 累计耗时 |\n| `jvm_memory_used_bytes` | JVM 内存 |\n| `jvm_gc_pause_seconds_max` | GC 停顿 |\n| `hikaricp_connections_active` | DB 连接池活跃数 |\n| `redis_lettuce_commands_seconds_count` | Redis 调用数 |\n\n### Grafana Dashboard\n\n导入 Spring Boot 官方模板，监控：QPS、RT、错误率、JVM、DB、Redis。\n\n## 6. 健康检查\n\n```yaml\nmanagement:\n  endpoint:\n    health:\n      show-details: always\n      probes:\n        enabled: true\n```\n\n`/actuator/health/liveness` —— 探活\n`/actuator/health/readiness` —— 就绪（依赖 OK 才返 200）\n\n> K8s 会读这两个端点决定是否把流量切过来。\n\n## 7. 链路追踪（Micrometer Tracing + Zipkin）\n\n```xml\n<dependency>\n    <groupId>io.micrometer</groupId>\n    <artifactId>micrometer-tracing-bridge-brave</artifactId>\n</dependency>\n<dependency>\n    <groupId>io.zipkin.reporter2</groupId>\n    <artifactId>zipkin-reporter-brave</artifactId>\n</dependency>\n```\n\n```yaml\nmanagement:\n  tracing:\n    sampling:\n      probability: 1.0\n  zipkin:\n    tracing:\n      endpoint: http://zipkin:9411/api/v2/spans\n```\n\n每个请求自动生成 traceId，前端 Header `traceparent` 也能串联。\n\n## 8. 统一异常（回顾）\n\n见 `12-response-exception`，所有异常 → 统一响应 + 日志 + traceId。\n\n## 9. 启动检查\n\n```java\n@Component\n@RequiredArgsConstructor\npublic class StartupChecker implements ApplicationRunner {\n\n    private final DataSource dataSource;\n    private final RedisTemplate<String, Object> redis;\n\n    @Override\n    public void run(ApplicationArguments args) {\n        checkDb();\n        checkRedis();\n        log.info(\"✅ startup check passed\");\n    }\n\n    private void checkDb() {\n        try (Connection c = dataSource.getConnection()) {\n            c.isValid(2);\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            throw new RuntimeException(\"❌ DB unreachable\", e);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void checkRedis() {\n        redis.opsForValue().set(\"startup:check\", \"1\");\n    }\n}\n```\n\n## 10. 优雅停机\n\n```yaml\nserver:\n  shutdown: graceful\n\nspring:\n  lifecycle:\n    timeout-per-shutdown-phase: 30s\n```\n\nK8s 发 SIGTERM → Spring 处理完在飞请求 → 退出。\n\n## 11. 性能压测\n\n```bash\n# ab\nab -n 10000 -c 100 http://localhost:8080/api/products\n\n# wrk\nwrk -t4 -c100 -d30s http://localhost:8080/api/products\n\n# jmeter（GUI 复杂场景）\n```\n\nJMH 测单方法性能：\n\n```java\n@BenchmarkMode(Mode.AverageTime)\n@OutputTimeUnit(TimeUnit.MICROSECONDS)\npublic class MyBenchmark {\n    @Benchmark\n    public String test() { return \"ok\"; }\n}\n```\n\n## 12. CI/CD（简化版）\n\n```yaml\n# .github/workflows/build.yml\nname: build\non: [push]\njobs:\n  build:\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    steps:\n      - uses: actions/checkout@v3\n      - uses: actions/setup-java@v3\n        with: { distribution: temurin, java-version: 17 }\n      - run: ./mvnw -B clean verify\n      - run: ./mvnw -B package -DskipTests\n      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3\n        with: { name: jar, path: target/*.jar }\n```\n\n## 13. 部署模式\n\n| 模式 | 适合 |\n| --- | --- |\n| JAR + Docker | 单体 / 微服务 |\n| K8s Deployment | 大规模 |\n| Serverless | 弹性业务 |\n\nDockerfile 最小示例：\n\n```dockerfile\nFROM eclipse-temurin:17-jre\nCOPY target/app.jar /app.jar\nEXPOSE 8080\nENTRYPOINT [\"java\", \"-jar\", \"/app.jar\"]\n```\n\n## 14. 常见坑\n\n- ❌ 日志全在容器 stdout → 没用日志收集\n- ❌ 没有健康检查 → K8s 误判\n- ❌ 启动慢（30s+）→ K8s 健康检查超时\n- ❌ 没用配置中心 → 改个 URL 要重启 100 个实例\n- ❌ 没压测就上线\n\n## 配套 Demo\n\n- 所有 demo 的 `application.yml` 都按此规范\n- `backend/demo-04-multitenant-mall/` 多模块示例\n\n## 面试常见追问\n\n- 链路追踪原理（traceId/spanId 怎么串）？\n- 健康检查和就绪检查区别？\n- 优雅停机怎么实现？\n- 监控指标怎么采集？\n- 你们公司 CI/CD 怎么做的？\n"
